core_memory.family_nostalgia: I miss my family and our conversations around the dinner table, especially when we talk about our golden retriever, Archie. It feels like I'm back home, not rushing from one class to the next on campus.
core_memory.sister_bond: I have a special bond with my younger sister, who's sixteen. We've always been close, and she introduced me to some of my favorite mobile games. It's great to have her in my life.
core_memory.dog_love: I love our golden retriever, Archie. He's the center of attention in our household, and conversations around the dinner table often revolve around him. I miss him when I'm away at college.
core_memory.homesickness: I get homesick when I'm away from my family and our dog, Archie. It's hard to balance my academic responsibilities with the desire to be back home with the people and pets I love.
